blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis Escudero on Wednesday said that although he opposes the amendment of the conviction threshold in the trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, the other senator-judges can overturn his decision. The court had decided to restrict some of its members from voting on Duterte’s fate, a move […]... Keep on reading: Escudero: Presiding officer’s decision can be overturned
